title: propertyPoint operation
description: Single-point property evaluation: at a given (T, P, composition) the thermo package reports every property the chosen models can compute (Psat, gamma_i, K_i, Cp_ig, H, S, Z, v, ...). Results print to the run log.

state.title: Thermodynamic state
state.description: The (T, P, composition) at which properties are evaluated.

properties.title: Properties to evaluate
properties.description: What to compute at the declared state. Fixed names (Z, molarVolume, v_molar, T_bubble, viscosity, surface_tension, thermal_conductivity, ...) and per-component patterns (Psat_<comp>, gamma_<comp>, y_eq_<comp>) — the same vocabulary the scan operations use. Omit to report the operation's default set.
